items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I told him I'd go play with Pete and his brother, Lafitte.

ctx.x: Yes, I remember when she just died a couple of years ago. His wife? Keogh's wife, yeah, in New York.
Yeah, she came down here with the station. I told him I'd go play with Pete and his brother, Lafitte.
It might have been four or five years ago.
